thread:
IncidentBot: ALERT: routing-policy-evaluator raised TTL-ERROR spikes; auto-fallback triggered. Observed 502/503 rate from hosted frontends -> 7% last 3m, correlated with route change to tier:d-quant-08.
Rohan: grabbing this — seeing a bunch of hosted traffic landing on dedicated pools. looks like the routing policy label for `variant:quant-08` got applied to `tier:dedicated` instead of `tier:hosted`.
Emily: paging oncall now. @Rohan drop an impact estimate pls.
Rohan: quick numbers: ~120 rps redirected, ~85% of those are short-lived chat requests (seq len<128), error uplift ~6.8% global for hosted customers. ~12 tenants had anomalous latency spikes, 3 reported increased error rates in last 10m.
Leo: confirmed same in logs: `route_eval: fallback->dedicated` with policy_id=pol-9774. That policy was edited 03:14 UTC. diff shows `target.tier = "dedicated"` where it should be `target.tier = "hosted"` for the variant mapping.
Emily: can we panic-gate that policy? put it into disabled state or rollback to prev commit.
Rohan: trying safe-action: `rbctl policy disable pol-9774 --force`
Rohan: ```
$ rbctl policy disable pol-9774 --force
-> success: policy pol-9774 disabled (user: rohan)
```
IncidentBot: SYSTEM: policy pol-9774 disabled by Rohan at 03:22:11 UTC. Auto-fallback suspended.
Emily: good — rerouting appears to reduce errors. metrics showing hosted 502 down from 6.8% -> 1.2% in 2m.
PagerDuty: paging escalation: severity=high; incident created ID INC-2026-4881.
Rohan: next steps: we need a controlled rollback + audit + canary verification. propose: 1) lock dedicated pools for non-routed traffic (quarantine); 2) revert policy to commit b3f9; 3) run synthetic canary (small percent) to validate; 4) notify customers.
Leo: quarantine command: `rbctl pool update dedicated-quant-08 --accept-hosted=false` — will prevent hosted traffic landing there while we reconcile.
Rohan: applied quarantine. CLI: ```
$ rbctl pool update dedicated-quant-08 --accept-hosted=false
-> updated pool dedicated-quant-08
```
Emily: real-time: latency for affected tenants dropping. good. @Customer Ops please draft outgoing note for tenants A, B, C (IDs: t-134, t-229, t-501) — they might have seen degraded responses between 03:14-03:22 UTC.
Customer Ops: drafting. ETA 12m. suggest include: summary, mitigation, ask to contact if persistent errors, and pointer to incident page INC-2026-4881.
Rohan: rolling policy config back now: `rbctl policy revert pol-9774 --to b3f9`
Rohan: ```
$ rbctl policy revert pol-9774 --to b3f9
-> success: pol-9774 reverted to b3f9 (user: rohan)
```
IncidentBot: CONFIG: policy pol-9774 reverted by Rohan at 03:31:02 UTC.
Emily: canary traffic started at 03:33 UTC to validate mapping. monitoring: small fraction routed to hosted as intended.
Leo: logs post-revert show `route_eval: variant=quant-08 -> target.tier=hosted` across canary.
Rohan: metrics look stable. hosted error baseline back to normal ~0.6%.
Emily: handoff: Rohan, you're primary for the next 30m while we watch. If anything regresses, escalate page to SRE lead. I'll T-30m remain on-call for coordination.
Rohan: ack -- will monitor dashboards and keep this thread updated.
PagerDuty: reminder: run post-incident checklist and add timeline to INC-2026-4881.
Customer Ops: outgoing message sent at 03:45 UTC to tenants t-134, t-229, t-501. Copy of message: "We observed a routing policy misconfiguration that briefly routed some hosted traffic to dedicated pools between 03:14-03:22 UTC. Impact: intermittent errors/latency for a small set of customers. Root cause: policy edit changed target tier. Mitigation: policy disabled and reverted; mitigation actions taken. If you still see issues please reach out."
Emily: root cause summary for postmortem: human edit to policy pol-9774 introduced wrong target filter `tier=d` vs `tier=h`. No code-level bug; gap in policy validation for tier-target labels.
Rohan: actionable items: 1) add server-side validation to block policy saves where target.tier mismatches variant set (owner: eng-runtime) 2) require two-step approval for policy edits that touch `target.tier` (owner: product + security) 3) add canary gate that verifies tier assignment for 1% traffic before full roll (owner: eng-ml).
Leo: logging note: add audit log entry that diffs `target` fields and alerts on tier changes. (owner: eng-infra).
IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to medium at 03:50 UTC.
Rohan: closing loop — metrics steady for 18m, no new tenant errors. I'll open the postmortem and tag owners.
Emily: thanks team. please add timeline and paste command outputs to INC-2026-4881.
Rohan: will do. handing over to @Emily at 04:02 UTC for follow-ups (on-call Handoff).
Emily: taking follow-up ownership. leaving the channel open for 1h for any customer escalations. :thumbsup:
